samples.title: Desk essentials
samples.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: sample input photo for an object detection web demo. Create one realistic square documentary photograph of a tidy wooden desk in natural window light. The three clear subjects are one open unbranded laptop with a blank dark screen, one ceramic coffee cup with a visible handle, and one closed plain hardcover book with visible pages. All three objects fully in frame, clearly separated, recognizable at thumbnail size, occupying much of the image. View from slightly above at a three-quarter angle. Natural textures and shadows, realistic proportions. No humans. No text, logos, watermarks, bounding boxes, detection labels or annotations. This is a photo, not a collage or a graphic.
